parsed.note_claim: NATO Article 5 applies only to armed attacks on member territory in Europe or North America, or specified North Atlantic areas north of the Tropic of Cancer.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: on the Islands under the jurisdiction of any of the Parties in the North Atlantic area north of the Tropic of Cancer
parsed.reason: The page contains the official text of Article 6 of the North Atlantic Treaty, which defines the geographic scope of Article 5 to include areas north of the Tropic of Cancer.
